Subtitle: Files between your PC and phone. Directly over your local network.
SecurityNote: Development preview: HTTP is not encrypted. Use a trusted private network. Keep Safari open during transfers.
NetworkLabel: Choose a network interface before starting sharing.
ServerMissing: Transfer server is missing. Build the solution or use the complete portable package.
ServerFailed: Could not start the transfer server. Check the selected interface and try again.
ConnectionLost: Connection to the local server was lost.
NoDevices: No devices yet. Scan the QR code with your phone.
LocalOnly: Local test mode. Choose a Wi-Fi or Ethernet address to connect a phone.
ScanQr: Scan this QR code on your phone. Approve the request here. QR codes expire after 10 minutes.
SelectRecipient: Connect and select a recipient first.
InvalidFile: Choose a file up to 10 GB.
ReadyForPhone: Files are ready for the selected phone to download.
DiagnosticHelp: This screen reads local interface information only. It does not test firewall rules or Wi-Fi client isolation. If your phone cannot connect, check both devices use the same local network, Windows firewall allows LAN Drop on the selected private/domain network, and guest Wi-Fi does not isolate clients. No network or firewall settings are changed.
NetworkBlocked: Sharing is blocked on Public or Unknown networks. Choose a trusted Private/Domain interface, or loopback for local testing.
OffersHelp: Approve each file before the phone can upload it. Requests expire after 10 minutes.
NetworkUnavailableStopped: Sharing stopped because the selected network address is no longer available. Choose a network and start again.
NetworkUnsafeStopped: Sharing stopped because the network profile became Public or Unknown. Choose a trusted network and start again.
Error_unsafe_folder: This folder uses a link or junction. Choose a direct local folder.
Error_insufficient_disk_space: There is not enough free disk space. Choose another folder or free space.
Error_storage_failure: Could not save the file. Check disk space and folder access.
Error_folder_access: Cannot write to the destination folder.
Error_invalid_address: The QR address must match the selected listening address.
Error_pairing_expired: The pairing link has expired. Create a new QR code on the PC.
Error_device_limit: Too many devices. Remove old requests on the PC.
Error_session_expired: The device session has expired. Connect again.
Error_invalid_action: Invalid or outdated action. Refresh the overview and try again.
Error_invalid_folder: Cannot use this folder. Choose an absolute local path and check permissions.
Error_length_required: A valid content length is required.
Error_file_too_large: The file size limit is exceeded.
Error_offer_limit: Too many file requests. Cancel old requests or wait for them to expire.
Error_offer_expired: This file request has expired. Choose the file again.
Error_offer_not_approved: The PC has not accepted this file. Send a new request.
Error_offer_required: Offer this file to the PC before sending it.
Error_offer_mismatch: The file does not match the accepted request. Send a new request.
Error_upload_limit: Too many active uploads. Try again shortly.
Error_file_limit: The registered file limit is reached. Remove shared files or restart sharing.
Error_storage_quota: The storage quota is exceeded. Remove prepared files and try again.
Error_incomplete_transfer: The transfer was not completed. Retry the file.
IntegrityFailed: The server did not confirm matching file contents. The transfer is not verified. Retry the file.
Error_checksum_mismatch: File contents did not match. Nothing was saved. Retry the file.
Error_checksum_required: A valid file checksum is required. Update LAN Drop and try again.
